snippet.title: Elansar
snippet.description: Elansar is a small myst like "point & click" adventure game. Explore an island and solve puzzles. Will you uncover the Island's mystery ? Available on Steam, Dreamcast and Atari Falcon here https://orionsoft.itch.io/elansar
